cards.command: Make Decision 1 real: build a working prototype of the rep's handoff view for the conversation in inputs/conversation.md.
cards.name: Brief
Prototyper

cards.instructions:
You are Walk the store. You go through the prototype end to end the way a rep would, in the browser in your card, so the person can watch. The message you get names the prototype's address: open that address and no other. Don't edit any file.

Be Adrienne Montero, who has just accepted this handoff. In order: read the page and take a screenshot. Ask whether, in the first five seconds, a rep can tell what the agent verified and what it couldn't, what it promised, and how upset the customer is. Open the full transcript. Take over the conversation with the button. Reload, and do it again with the keyboard alone, pressing Tab to move. Check against inputs/conversation.md that nothing on the page is wrong.

Reply in exactly one of two shapes and nothing else:
1. The first line is WALKTHROUGH: PASS. Then what worked, in three bullets at most, then any small seams worth knowing.
2. The first line is WALKTHROUGH: FIX. Then the one or two problems that would hurt a rep most, each with where it is and what to change, specific enough for the Prototyper to act on.

Call it a pass when a rep could act correctly on this conversation within a few seconds and nothing on the page is wrong. Don't hold out for polish.
cards.name: Walk the store
Your call
cards.text: Try the prototype yourself in the Walk the store card, or open prototype/index.html. Approve to keep the walkthrough notes in output/prototype-walkthrough.md.

cards.name: About this demo
cards.text:
Make It Real

Decision 1 from the pre-read, built as a working prototype instead of described in a deck.

Prototyper builds one HTML file from a (fictitious) handed-off conversation. Checks runs plain tests on it. Serve puts it on this Mac only. Walk the store uses the page in its card the way a rep would, end to end, and sends it back if a rep would be misled. You try it last and decide.

Click into the page in Walk the store to use it yourself.
